name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Seven Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv's two Dnipro bridges on 17 Nov; power cut in three regions
state: President Zelensky said seven Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv's two main Dnipro bridges overnight into 17 Nov; both were closed and Mayor Klitschko said water and heating supplies were disrupted (Kyiv Post). Zelensky reported significant power outages in Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv and Zaporizhzhia regions after grid strikes (Kyiv Independent). Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge for a second day on 17 Nov (The Moscow Times). Sustained mass strikes on infrastructure keep the Alert.
for_you: Travel to Ukraine is advised against by the FCDO. Expect continued effects on European energy and grain markets.
rubric_hit: Mass strikes on infrastructure, major escalation = Alert
